describe: identity content pack
tests.title: every shipped image exists, has an allowed licence, an author or credit field, and a Commons source page
tests.title_template: every shipped image exists, has an allowed licence, an author or credit field, and a Commons source page
tests.checks: For every asset in public/content/registry.json: the file exists under public/, licence matches the allow-list regex, source is a Wikimedia Commons URL, statement is wikidata Q#P41/P94/P18, size > 100 bytes.
tests.risk_note: No assertion that pack.assets is non-empty; observed 2510 assertions (502 assets x 5).
tests.limitations: Checks registry metadata only, not the image content or the licence on the source page; the allow-list also accepts unversioned 'CC BY'.

describe: identity content pack
tests.title: assets, texts and characters only reference entities that exist in the database
tests.title_template: assets, texts and characters only reference entities that exist in the database
tests.checks: Every asset, entity text and character in the content pack references an entity id present in the database.
tests.limitations: Referential integrity only.

describe: identity content pack
tests.title: flags and arms are never shown outside 1836–1936 or outside their recorded period
tests.title_template: flags and arms are never shown outside 1836–1936 or outside their recorded period
tests.checks: Every non-portrait asset (flag/arms) has a recorded period that overlaps 1836–1936.
tests.pass_condition: Overlap holds for every flag/arms asset.
tests.risk_note: No non-empty guard; observed 275 assertions (176 flags + 99 arms).
tests.limitations: The title says assets are 'never shown' outside their period; the test checks only the data overlap with the game span, not the UI date selection logic.

describe: identity content pack
tests.title: unqualified symbols of present-day states, peoples, regions and eras were rejected, not shipped
tests.title_template: unqualified symbols of present-day states, peoples, regions and eras were rejected, not shipped
tests.checks: For linked entities of kind people/region/period, every shipped non-portrait asset has quality 'supported'; plus asset ids are unique.
tests.pass_condition: Inner expectations hold; shipped.size equals asset count.
tests.risk_note: Observed 1 assertion (only the id-uniqueness check). The probe shows 68 targeted entities and 0 non-portrait assets shipped for them, so the quality check never ran. The property 'none shipped' holds, but the test cannot distinguish 'correctly rejected' from 'lookup returns nothing'.
tests.limitations: Does not assert that the expected rejections are recorded (historical_data/assets/review.json).

describe: identity content pack
tests.title: every text carries article, URL, revision and the CC BY-SA licence
tests.title_template: every text carries article, URL, revision and the CC BY-SA licence
tests.checks: Every entity and character text carries a vi/en Wikipedia URL, revision id > 0, licence 'CC BY-SA 4.0' and > 40 characters.
tests.pass_condition: All texts satisfy the fields; at least one text exists.
tests.limitations: Checks attribution fields in data, not that the UI displays them (G-a requirement).

describe: AI does not get stuck in meaningless loops
tests.title: no law flips back to a value it left within 15 years
tests.title_template: no law flips back to a value it left within 15 years
tests.checks: No country re-adopts, within 180 ticks, a law value it had left (flip-back).
tests.pass_condition: No flip-back among same-group pairs closer than 180 ticks.
tests.risk_note: 0 assertions executed. The AI never changes the same law group twice within 180 ticks (guard at src/engine/ai/ai.ts:119), so the pairs the test inspects never exist; the probe found 174 law changes and 0 same-group pairs within 180 ticks. The test cannot fail under the current engine and checks nothing at runtime.
tests.limitations: Vacuous; the behaviour is enforced by code, not verified by the test.

describe: AI does not get stuck in meaningless loops
tests.title: wars end: no war lasts more than 12 years
tests.title_template: wars end: no war lasts more than 12 years
tests.checks: Every war still active at the end of the run is at most 145 ticks old.
tests.pass_condition: st.tick - start ≤ 145 for wars in st.wars.
tests.risk_note: 0 assertions executed: no war was active at the end (probe: 26 wars ended during the run, 0 active at tick 480). Ended wars are never inspected. The engine ends wars after 144 months (src/engine/systems/military.ts:128); the probe found the longest ended war lasted 145 months. The title says '12 years' while the bound is 145 ticks.
tests.limitations: Vacuous for this scenario.
